policy.control_inputs: Navigation, NanoDet front RGB, camera-measured signal color, lidar and forward radar. The pass planner also measures both lanes in 360-degree lidar. Discretionary lane changes use the surveyed adjacent lane and ego-motion-compensated lidar returns.
policy.display_inputs: Five registered RGB cameras, 360-degree lidar and five Doppler radars.

surround.coordinates: ego metres, +x forward, +y right, +z up; level mounts, yaw in degrees

capture_checkout.note: Archive hashes identify the exact execution sources, including working tree edits.
